implementation: Explicit source-guarded complete frozen RBPF step caller with one-time move staging

summary: ========= LEAK SUMMARY: 0 bytes leaked in 0 allocations

plan.scope: Entire frozen RBPF step over seeded synthetic epoch inputs, including move generation exactly once per held particle, conditionals, mass/FIX decision and resampling. Extraction and integer-search inputs are fixtures. Graph solving/real data are excluded.
plan.method: One allowed CPU, one BLAS thread, normal priority, nonexclusive host/GPU. Serial rotating five-mode groups; paired within-group reductions median per round then median five rounds. Setup/restore/validation/serialization outside step timer. One workspace, one score batch per epoch, no numerical cache across epochs.
plan.gate: For each candidate vs original: >=10% paired reduction and >=4/5 positive rounds, A/A absolute paired median <5%. GPU-specific screen additionally needs same vs native_cpu. Diagnostic only; no default adoption without full-route multi-seed accuracy and whole graph performance.
plan.validation: Exact discrete decisions/RNG and conditional position/P bits; scalar staging all numeric bits exact; native continuous state difference <1e-10 as a diagnostic, not a changed accuracy threshold. No retry to obtain a pass.

field_prefix.scope: One unpinned 400-epoch run3/seed prefix; 200 actual PF steps. Timing is descriptive, not a paired performance gate. Complete routes and multiple seeds are still required for adoption.

python_memory.scope: One untimed warmed call per mode/condition; tracemalloc Python allocations only. Native/CUDA allocations and context excluded. Staged candidate storage grows with all requested moves; no pruning.

preserved_behavior: All original move candidates, duplicate-candidate priors, particle order and RNG calls; extend/shrink exactly once per held particle. No speculative double generation.

Only the move loop is replaced. Original extraction, maintenance, shadow/debug cache, burst score, state commit, conditionals, FIX, feedback, resampling and cluster publication stay in their original order.

FP64 numeric model and original IRLS counts retained. Native backend is unchanged D226 DLL. Strict/underflow-warning policies call original complete step before staging. Unsupported batch inputs keep every requested score via scalar fallback.
numerical_limits: Scalar staging is bit-identical in all timed synthetic states. Native LL arithmetic is not NumPy-bit-identical.
